foundations.title: Business Creation & Digital Foundations — One-on-One
foundations.headline: Build your business, from idea to launch.
foundations.audience: Aspiring entrepreneurs and business owners building a shop, local service, tourism venture or digital business.

modules.title: Week 1 · Business foundations
modules.body: Validate an idea, choose a model, price your offer, cover registration and banking basics, and create your brand.

modules.title: Week 2 · Website development
modules.body: Set up domains, hosting and email; build your website with AI, useful copy, mobile design and SEO basics.

modules.title: Week 3 · Digital marketing
modules.body: Plan social media, AI content, email follow-up and analytics.

modules.title: Week 4 · Affiliate marketing
modules.body: Choose programmes and a niche, create helpful reviews and disclosures, track referrals and improve conversions.

modules.title: Weeks 5–6 · Advertising and video production
modules.body: Work on Meta and Google ads, retargeting and AI promotional video. Capstone: launch and review your live campaign.

sessions.title: Business idea and customer validation
sessions.body: Choose a customer problem, interview potential buyers and test demand.

sessions.title: Business model, pricing and legal basics
sessions.body: Plan revenue, costs, pricing, registration and local obligations.

sessions.title: Brand and business setup
sessions.body: Develop your name, logo and story; plan banking and practical setup.

sessions.title: Domains, hosting and professional email
sessions.body: Choose and connect the foundations of your business website.

sessions.title: Build your website with AI
sessions.body: Create useful pages, copy and a clear customer journey using AI tools.

sessions.title: Website launch, SEO and analytics
sessions.body: Check mobile layouts, search visibility and basic visitor measurement.

sessions.title: Social media strategy
sessions.body: Choose channels and plan a useful content calendar.

sessions.title: Create content with AI
sessions.body: Create and review practical social, written and visual content.

sessions.title: Email marketing and customer follow-up
sessions.body: Build a follow-up process and use analytics to improve it.

sessions.title: Affiliate niches and programmes
sessions.body: Select relevant programmes and products suited to your audience.

sessions.title: Helpful reviews and clear disclosures
sessions.body: Create honest reviews and comparisons with affiliate disclosures.

sessions.title: Referral tracking and conversions
sessions.body: Set up links, measure referrals and improve the customer journey.

sessions.title: Facebook and Instagram advertising
sessions.body: Plan targeting, budget and creative around a real offer.

sessions.title: AI promotional video production
sessions.body: Plan and produce a useful promotional video with AI tools.

sessions.title: Google Ads and search campaigns
sessions.body: Understand search intent, keywords, landing pages and budgets.

sessions.title: Retargeting and campaign refinement
sessions.body: Plan retargeting and improve the message and landing-page experience.

sessions.title: Launch your campaign
sessions.body: Publish your business campaign and test the customer journey.

sessions.title: Business launch capstone and review
sessions.body: Review the live campaign, measure early signals and plan mentorship priorities.

outcomes: Validate your business idea, offer and pricing
Plan legal registration, banking and your brand
Build and launch a professional website with AI
Use social, email, affiliate marketing and analytics
Create advertisements and promotional videos, then launch a campaign

software.title: AI, Coding & Software Development — One-on-One
software.headline: Build the tools your business needs.
software.audience: Business owners, freelancers and learners ready to use AI, build software, improve WordPress sites and offer automation or training services.

modules.title: Week 1 · AI and automation foundations
modules.body: Master practical prompting, map business workflows and scope automation audits.

modules.title: Week 2 · Business automation
modules.body: Build chatbot, booking, CRM, marketing, invoicing and administrative workflows.

modules.title: Week 3 · WordPress and AI-assisted coding
modules.body: Build with WordPress and AI, understand code, review changes and debug common errors.

modules.title: Weeks 4–5 · Software, APIs and launch
modules.body: Use AI app builders, databases and APIs to build one working software project. Test, debug and deploy; cover pricing, licensing and software services.

modules.title: Week 6 · AI training for institutions
modules.body: Design a curriculum, practise workshop facilitation and write proposals for business or institutional audiences. Capstone: show your software and deliver a mini-training.

sessions.title: AI fundamentals and prompting
sessions.body: Use AI safely for research, reasoning, content and business tasks.

sessions.title: Practical prompt workflows
sessions.body: Build reusable prompts and review output quality against your goals.

sessions.title: Automation mapping and audits
sessions.body: Map business processes and scope an automation audit as a service.

sessions.title: Chatbots, bookings and customer enquiries
sessions.body: Design a useful chatbot and connect enquiries or booking workflows.

sessions.title: CRM and marketing automation
sessions.body: Organise leads and build practical follow-up and marketing workflows.

sessions.title: Invoicing and administrative automation
sessions.body: Automate a focused repeatable business task and review the result.

sessions.title: AI-assisted WordPress planning
sessions.body: Plan a WordPress website, pages, plugins and a clear customer journey.

sessions.title: Build and improve WordPress with AI
sessions.body: Use AI to build content, layouts and integrations while reviewing quality.

sessions.title: AI-assisted coding foundations
sessions.body: Read, adapt and debug code with AI; understand files, versions and errors.

sessions.title: No-code and AI application builders
sessions.body: Turn a defined problem into an app prototype using appropriate tools.

sessions.title: Databases, APIs and integrations
sessions.body: Connect data, accounts and external services with appropriate access controls.

sessions.title: Build your software project
sessions.body: Implement the core workflow of your own AI tool, app or business programme.

sessions.title: Testing and debugging
sessions.body: Test the main user journey, fix problems and review security basics.

sessions.title: Deployment and software launch
sessions.body: Ship a working project and plan ongoing hosting and maintenance.

sessions.title: Pricing, licensing and AI services
sessions.body: Package and price software, automation audits and delivery services.

sessions.title: Design AI training for institutions
sessions.body: Create a practical curriculum for a business, government or community audience.

sessions.title: Workshop delivery and proposals
sessions.body: Practise facilitation and prepare a clear institutional training proposal.

sessions.title: Software and mini-training capstone
sessions.body: Demonstrate your working software project and deliver a short training session.

outcomes: Use practical AI prompting and automation workflows
Build chatbots, CRM and customer-service automations
Develop WordPress websites with AI-assisted coding
Build, test and deploy one working software project using APIs and databases
Price and deliver software, automation audits and AI training for institutions
